approve(address,uint256).details: See {IERC20-approve}. NOTE: If `amount` is the maximum `uint256`, the allowance is not updated on `transferFrom`. This is semantically equivalent to an infinite approval. Requirements: - `spender` cannot be the zero address.

params.symbol_: Symbol of the pool's LP token
params.totalDebtLimit_: Initial total debt limit, `type(uint256).max` for no limit

decreaseAllowance(address,uint256).details: Atomically decreases the allowance granted to `spender` by the caller. This is an alternative to {approve} that can be used as a mitigation for problems described in {IERC20-approve}. Emits an {Approval} event indicating the updated allowance. Requirements: - `spender` cannot be the zero address. - `spender` must have allowance for the caller of at least `subtractedValue`.

params.receiver: Account to mint pool shares to

depositWithReferral(uint256,address,uint.details: Same as `deposit`, but allows to specify the referral code

increaseAllowance(address,uint256).details: Atomically increases the allowance granted to `spender` by the caller. This is an alternative to {approve} that can be used as a mitigation for problems described in {IERC20-approve}. Emits an {Approval} event indicating the updated allowance. Requirements: - `spender` cannot be the zero address.

params.creditAccount: Credit account to send the funds to

params.receiver: Account to mint pool shares to

returns.assets: Amount of underlying transferred from caller

mintWithReferral(uint256,address,uint256.details: Same as `mint`, but allows to specify the referral code

name().details: Returns the name of the token.

paused().details: Returns true if the contract is paused, and false otherwise.

params.owner: Account to burn pool shares from
params.shares: Number of pool shares to redeem

repayCreditAccount(uint256,uint256,uint2.custom:expects: Credit manager transfers underlying from a credit account to the pool before calling this functionProfit/loss computed in the credit manager are cosistent with pool's implicit calculations

params.loss: Pool's loss in underlying after repaying
params.profit: Pool's profit in underlying after repaying

params.creditManager: Credit manager to set the limit for
params.newLimit: New debt limit, `type(uint256).max` for no limit (has smaller priority than total debt limit)

params.newInterestRateModel: Address of the new interest rate model contract

params.newPoolQuotaKeeper: Address of the new pool quota keeper contract

params.newLimit: New debt limit, `type(uint256).max` for no limit

symbol().details: Returns the symbol of the token, usually a shorter version of the name.

totalAssets().details: Since `totalAssets` doesn't depend on underlying balance, pool is not vulnerable to the inflation attack

transfer(address,uint256).details: See {IERC20-transfer}. Requirements: - `to` cannot be the zero address. - the caller must have a balance of at least `amount`.

transferFrom(address,address,uint256).details: See {IERC20-transferFrom}. Emits an {Approval} event indicating the updated allowance. This is not required by the EIP. See the note at the beginning of {ERC20}. NOTE: Does not update the allowance if the current allowance is the maximum `uint256`. Requirements: - `from` and `to` cannot be the zero address. - `from` must have a balance of at least `amount`. - the caller must have allowance for ``from``'s tokens of at least `amount`.

params.owner: Account to burn pool shares from

_baseInterestIndexLU.details: Cumulative base interest index stored as of last update in ray

_baseInterestRate.details: Current base interest rate in ray

_creditManagerSet.details: List of all connected credit managers

_expectedLiquidityLU.details: Expected liquidity stored as of last update

CallerNotConfiguratorException().notice: Thrown on attempting to call an access restricted function not as configurator

CallerNotControllerException().notice: Thrown on attempting to call an access restricted function not as controller or configurator

CallerNotCreditManagerException().notice: Thrown on attempting to call an access restricted function not as credit manager

CallerNotPausableAdminException().notice: Thrown on attempting to pause a contract without pausable admin rights

CallerNotPoolQuotaKeeperException().notice: Thrown on attempting to call an access restricted function not as quota keeper

CallerNotUnpausableAdminException().notice: Thrown on attempting to unpause a contract without unpausable admin rights

CreditManagerCantBorrowException().notice: Thrown when a credit manager attempts to borrow more than its limit in the current block, or in general

IncompatibleCreditManagerException().notice: Thrown by pool-adjacent contracts when a credit manager being connected has a wrong pool address

IncompatiblePoolQuotaKeeperException().notice: Thrown when attempting to connect a quota keeper to an incompatible pool

RegisteredCreditManagerOnlyException().notice: Thrown when an address is expected to be a registered credit manager, but is not

ZeroAddressException().notice: Thrown on attempting to set an important address to zero address

IncurUncoveredLoss(address,uint256).notice: Emitted when incurred loss can't be fully covered by burning treasury's shares

Refer(address,uint256,uint256).notice: Emitted when depositing liquidity with referral code

Repay(address,uint256,uint256,uint256).notice: Emitted when credit account's debt is repaid to the pool

SetCreditManagerDebtLimit(address,uint25.notice: Emitted when new debt limit is set for a credit manager

SetPoolQuotaKeeper(address).notice: Emitted when new pool quota keeper contract is set

SetTotalDebtLimit(uint256).notice: Emitted when new total debt limit is set

SetWithdrawFee(uint256).notice: Emitted when new withdrawal fee is set

baseInterestIndex().notice: Current cumulative base interest index in ray

baseInterestIndexLU().notice: Cumulative base interest index stored as of last update in ray

baseInterestRate().notice: Annual interest rate in ray that credit account owners pay per unit of borrowed capital

creditManagerBorrowable(address).notice: Amount available to borrow for a given credit manager

creditManagerBorrowed(address).notice: Amount borrowed by a given credit manager

creditManagerDebtLimit(address).notice: Debt limit for a given credit manager, `type(uint256).max` means no limit

creditManagers().notice: Addresses of all connected credit managers

decimals().notice: Pool shares decimals, matches underlying token decimals

deposit(uint256,address).notice: Deposits given amount of underlying tokens to the pool in exchange for pool shares

expectedLiquidity().notice: Amount of underlying that would be in the pool if debt principal, base interest         and quota revenue were fully repaid

expectedLiquidityLU().notice: Expected liquidity stored as of last update

lastBaseInterestUpdate().notice: Timestamp of the last base interest rate and index update

lastQuotaRevenueUpdate().notice: Timestamp of the last quota revenue update

lendCreditAccount(uint256,address).notice: Lends funds to a credit account, can only be called by credit managers

maxDeposit(address).notice: Maximum amount of underlying that can be deposited to the pool, 0 if pool is on pause

maxMint(address).notice: Maximum number of pool shares that can be minted, 0 if pool is on pause

maxRedeem(address).notice: Maximum number of shares that can be redeemed for underlying by `owner`, 0 if pool is on pause

maxWithdraw(address).notice: Maximum amount of underlying that can be withdrawn from the pool by `owner`, 0 if pool is on pause

mint(uint256,address).notice: Deposits underlying tokens to the pool in exhcange for given number of pool shares

pause().notice: Pauses contract, can only be called by an account with pausable admin role

previewDeposit(uint256).notice: Number of pool shares that would be minted on depositing `assets`

previewMint(uint256).notice: Amount of underlying that would be spent to mint `shares`

previewRedeem(uint256).notice: Amount of underlying that would be received after redeeming `shares`

previewWithdraw(uint256).notice: Number of pool shares that would be burned on withdrawing `assets`

quotaRevenue().notice: Current annual quota revenue in underlying tokens

redeem(uint256,address,address).notice: Redeems given number of pool shares for underlying tokens

repayCreditAccount(uint256,uint256,uint2.notice: Updates pool state to indicate debt repayment, can only be called by credit managers         after transferring underlying from a credit account to the pool.         - If transferred amount exceeds debt principal + base interest + quota interest,           the difference is deemed protocol's profit and the respective number of shares           is minted to the treasury.         - If, however, transferred amount is insufficient to repay debt and interest,           which may only happen during liquidation, treasury's shares are burned to           cover as much of the loss as possible.

setController(address).notice: Sets new external controller, can only be called by configurator

setCreditManagerDebtLimit(address,uint25.notice: Sets new debt limit for a given credit manager, can only be called by controller         Adds credit manager to the list of connected managers when called for the first time

setInterestRateModel(address).notice: Sets new interest rate model, can only be called by configurator

setPoolQuotaKeeper(address).notice: Sets new pool quota keeper, can only be called by configurator

setTotalDebtLimit(uint256).notice: Sets new total debt limit, can only be called by controller

setWithdrawFee(uint256).notice: Sets new withdrawal fee, can only be called by controller

supplyRate().notice: Annual interest rate in ray that liquidity providers receive per unit of deposited capital,         consists of base interest and quota revenue

totalAssets().notice: Total amount of underlying tokens managed by the pool, same as `expectedLiquidity`

totalDebtLimit().notice: Total debt limit, `type(uint256).max` means no limit

unpause().notice: Unpauses contract, can only be called by an account with unpausable admin role

updateQuotaRevenue(int256).notice: Updates quota revenue value by given delta

withdraw(uint256,address,address).notice: Withdraws pool shares for given amount of underlying tokens
